The R-value of the roof assembly will be upgraded to the new R-value for the assigned code, which can be found in Table 12 (non-California) and Table 13 (California). If the roof insulation of a building is already at the desired code level, no changes will be made. Note that these tables contain some duplicative information to the tables in Section 2.3.2; however, Table 12 does not include the pre-1980 and 1980–2004 templates, but it does include the 90.1-2016 and 90.1-2019 templates.
